messages:
maya: FYI staging started spiking 502s on /v1/embeds after we rolled the quant revert. Looks like a serializer shape change. Need a hotfix push and image pin. Suggest: `gcr.io/redwood/release/embed-serializer-fix:2024-07-13-rc3`.

deploybot: Deploy request queued (ID=dr-9002). Required approvals: oncall, infra. Canary recommended: 4m. expedited=true.

lee: Oncall here, I can own it. How many requests affected in prod baseline?

maya: Staging ~4% errors, prod path traffic ~0.7% of total but could cascade in upstream batching. Rollback triggers: error_rate delta >= 1.5% sustained 5m OR p95 > 900ms.

maya: Quick rollback steps pasted:
```
# set image back
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/embed-service embed=gcr.io/redwood/release/embed:2024-07-10
kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/embed-service
# emergency undo
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/embed-service
```

zane: Infra +1 for expedited. I can carve a 12m midwindow at 18:05 UTC. Need release notes URL and a one-liner for the changelog. Also pin configmap hash in the release.

lee: I'll approve if staging ran a clean canary for >=12m. Do we have telemetry for that?

maya: Staging canary ran for 14m post-fix with no regressions. Evidence: logs + grafana panel snapshot saved to the release doc. Release note: https://docs.redwood.com/releases/embed-2024-07-13-serializer-fix (short: fix serializer shape mismatch after quant revert; pin image rc3; rollback policy included). Configmap hash: `cfg: b91d3f`.

maya: deploybot run: `expedite --id dr-9002 --force --midwindow 12m --notify #eng-releases,#incidents`

deploybot: Expedited deploy scheduled: dr-9002 -> prod. Canary 4m, progressive rollout after. Midwindow reserved 12m starting 1725008900. Monitors: embeds.errors, embeddings.p95_latency, kvcache.hit_rate. Watchers: lee, zane, maya. Logs tail command: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=k8s_container AND resource.labels.cluster_name=prod" --limit 100`

ops-bot: Alerting ramp 20s. Bound runbook: /runbooks/embed-serializer-fix. Pager: if embeddings.errors > 1.5% for 5m -> escalate to ops-lead and open incident.

lee: Oncall ACK. I'll be watching p95 and error delta. If we cross thresholds I'll trigger rollback and post back here + page #incidents.

maya: Thanks all. After stabilization I'll write a short blameless postmortem and attach the canary charts. :white_check_mark:
